scientific_question: Can every Linux CPython 3.11-active Hindsight dependency be acquired as a hash-matching compatible wheel from its exclusive frozen registry route?
decision_informed: Whether a retained wheelhouse can support a later network-free Hindsight environment installation.
scientific_evidence_role: Dependency acquisition evidence only; no package installation, model, service, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible.

resource_gate.start_condition: Wave1 controller is independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, every Wave1 model service and evaluator has stopped, at least 10 GiB is free under the project volume, and no process references either fresh output root.
resource_gate.why: This stage performs sustained network and disk I/O and must not perturb the sole active numerical comparison workload.

acceptance: All Python, pip, platform, routing-record, and routed-requirement identities match before download.
Exactly 198 PyPI and 1 PyTorch CPU active unique requirement names are selected under the frozen target marker environment.
Each route uses only its explicit HTTPS index with zero retries, no dependency resolution, required hashes, and binary-only acquisition.
Exactly 199 unique, target-compatible wheels are retained; their normalized distribution names exactly equal the active requirements and total bytes do not exceed 6 GiB.
Every wheel, log, and terminal record has retained size and SHA-256 evidence, and no dependency is installed.
failure: Any collision, gate violation, toolchain/input identity mismatch, network or hash failure, missing wheel, sdist, incompatible tag, duplicate/missing distribution, count mismatch, byte-ceiling breach, or timeout seals the fresh evidence root TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves the partial wheelhouse.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the complete wheelhouse, archive it, then freeze a fresh Python 3.11 environment installation using --no-index and only the retained two-route wheelhouse. Acquisition acceptance never authorizes installation or numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: starting before Wave1 terminal acceptance and complete Wave1 service release
using pip configuration, a mirror, an extra index, cache, retry, dependency resolution, source distribution, or altered requirement
installing into or modifying the shared Python 3.11 environment
deleting a partial/rejected wheelhouse or any earlier evidence root
populating numerical comparison cells or making a SOTA claim from dependency acquisition
